description: This file defines the ScreenPermission entity class for the OrangeHRM project, using Doctrine ORM annotations. It models access permissions (read, create, update, delete) for specific screens associated with user roles in the system.

classes.name: ScreenPermission
classes.description: Entity class representing permissions for a screen assigned to a user role, including CRUD permissions and relationships to UserRole and Screen entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the ScreenPermission record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the ScreenPermission record.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether delete permission is granted.
